data.name: Ittifaq
data.gender_notes: Ittifaq is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: It refers to an agreement or treaty between two parties, signifying trust and commitment in Islam. The name is derived from the Arabic root 'w-f-q', meaning 'to agree', 'to join', or 'to establish a bond'. The name Ittifaq carries the meaning “Agreement, Treaty” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ittifaq usually hope their child will grow to embody agreement, treaty and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ittifaq total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: إتفاق

in_arabic.long_meaning: إتفاق هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'و-ف-ق' والذي يعني التوافق والاتفاق بين الأشياء أو الأشخاص. يشير إلى الانسجام والتلاؤم في العلاقات أو الأفعال. في السياق الإسلامي، يمكن أن يعني الاتفاق على الخير والتوافق على الأفعال الصالحة.
